notes: Both routes meet at شعبة (ح); the text writes «عن عمرو بن مرة» once after it, so those three names are the shared tail (rule 3).
«فأرسلنا رجلا إلى ابن عباس» sends an envoy in the scene only; ابن عباس answers («فقال ابن عباس»), so he is the last link: occurrence 2.
«قال أهللنا رمضان» is Abu al-Bakhtari's own account of the story.
